156 static int32_t dpuRangeCfarProcDDMA_numDopplerGatesPerPing(uint32_t numRangeBins,
157  uint32_t numDopFFTBins,
158  uint32_t bytesPerSample,
159  uint32_t bankSizeBytes,
160  uint32_t *numDopplerGatesPerPing,
161  uint32_t *cfarInSize,
162  uint32_t *numLoops)
163 {
164  uint32_t dopplerGateSize = numRangeBins * bytesPerSample;
165  int32_t retVal = 0;
166 
167  *numDopplerGatesPerPing = bankSizeBytes / dopplerGateSize;
168 
169  *numLoops = ((numDopFFTBins + *numDopplerGatesPerPing - 1U) / *numDopplerGatesPerPing) / 2U; /* divide by 2 for ping and pong */
170 
171  if(*numLoops < 1U)
172  {
173  *numLoops = 1U;
174  }
175 
176  while((numDopFFTBins % (*numLoops)) != 0U)
177  {
178  numLoops++;
179  }
180 
181  *numDopplerGatesPerPing = numDopFFTBins / ((*numLoops) * 2U);
182  *cfarInSize = dopplerGateSize * (*numDopplerGatesPerPing);
183  if(*cfarInSize == 0U)
184  {
185  retVal = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWADDMA_CFARINSIZE_ERR;
186  goto exit;
187  }
188 
189  if ((numDopFFTBins % ((*numLoops) * 2U)) != 0U)
190  {
191  retVal = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWADDMA_NUM_GATES_PER_PING_ERR;
192  goto exit;
193  }
194 
195 exit:
196  return retVal;
197 
198 }

210 static inline int32_t DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_configHwa
211 (
212  DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Obj *obj,
213  DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Config *cfg
214 )
215 {
216  HWA_ParamConfig hwaParamCfg;
217  HWA_InterruptConfig paramISRConfig;
218  int32_t errCode;
219  uint8_t destChan;
220  uint8_t pingHwParamsetIdx = cfg->res.hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx,
221  pongHwParamsetIdx = pingHwParamsetIdx + 1U;
222  uint8_t cfarAvgRight, cfarAvgLeft, cfarGuardCells;
223  uint32_t index;
224 
225  for (index = 0; index < cfg->res.hwaCfg.numParamSet; index++)
226  {
227  errCode = HWA_disableParamSetInterrupt(obj->hwaHandle, (uint8_t)index + pingHwParamsetIdx,
228  HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_CPU_INTR1 | HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA);
229  if (errCode != 0)
230  {
231  goto exit;
232  }
233  }
234 
235  (void)memset((void *)&hwaParamCfg, 0, sizeof(hwaParamCfg));
236 
237  /*******************************/
238  /* PING RANGE CFAR PARAMSET */
239  /*******************************/
240  {
241  {
242 
243  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
244  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = obj->hwaDmaTriggerSourcePingPongIn[0];
245 
246  hwaParamCfg.accelMode = HWA_ACCELMODE_CFAR;
247 
248  cfarAvgRight = obj->rangeCfarCfg->winLen >> 1;
249  cfarAvgLeft = obj->rangeCfarCfg->winLen >> 1;
250  cfarGuardCells = obj->rangeCfarCfg->guardLen;
251 
252  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.peakGroupEn = obj->rangeCfarCfg->peakGroupingEn;
253  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.operMode = HWA_CFAR_OPER_MODE_LOG_INPUT_REAL; /* cfarInpMode = 1, cfarLogMode = 1, cfarAbsMode = 00b */
254  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.numGuardCells = cfarGuardCells;
255  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.nAvgDivFactor = obj->rangeCfarCfg->noiseDivShift; // not applicable in CFAR_OS
256  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.cyclicModeEn = obj->rangeCfarCfg->cyclicMode;
257  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.nAvgMode = obj->rangeCfarCfg->averageMode;
258  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.numNoiseSamplesRight = cfarAvgRight;
259  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.numNoiseSamplesLeft = cfarAvgLeft;
260  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.outputMode = HWA_CFAR_OUTPUT_MODE_I_PEAK_IDX_Q_NEIGHBOR_NOISE_VAL;
261  if (obj->rangeCfarCfg->averageMode == HWA_NOISE_AVG_MODE_CFAR_OS)
262  {
263  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.cfarOsKvalue = obj->rangeCfarCfg->osKvalue;
264  hwaParamCfg.accelModeArgs.cfarMode.cfarOsEdgeKScaleEn = obj->rangeCfarCfg->osEdgeKscaleEn;
265  }
266 
267  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWADDMA_ADDR_CFAR_PING_IN;
268 
269  if(obj->rangeCfarCfg->cyclicMode == 1U)
270  {
271  /* ACNT is equal to the number of samples to be loaded into the sliding buffer including the cyclic rotation */
272  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcnt = (uint16_t)obj->numCfarSamples - 1U + (2U * (uint16_t)cfarAvgRight) +
273  (2U * (uint16_t)cfarGuardCells) + (2U * (uint16_t)cfarAvgLeft);
274  /* Since for the first sample the window starts from the end due to cyclic rotation, this gives offset of first sample of the window for first cell under test*/
275  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcircShift = (uint16_t)obj->numCfarSamples - ((2U * (uint16_t)cfarAvgRight) + (uint16_t)cfarGuardCells);
276 
277  /* Finally this tells the size of the array, around which cyclic rotation has to be done */
278  if ((obj->numCfarSamples % 3U) == 0U)
279  { /* If numSamples % 3 == 0 */
280  hwaParamCfg.source.srcCircShiftWrap3 = 1; /* 'b001, means wrap in A dim */
281  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcircShiftWrap = mathUtils_ceilLog2(obj->numCfarSamples / 3U);
282  }
283  else
284  {
285  hwaParamCfg.source.srcCircShiftWrap3 = 0;
286  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcircShiftWrap = mathUtils_ceilLog2(obj->numCfarSamples);
287  }
288  }
289  else
290  {
291  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAcnt = (uint16_t)obj->numCfarSamples - 1U;
292  }
293 
294  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAIdx = (int32_t)obj->numDopplerGatesPerPing * (int32_t)obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample;
295  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBIdx = (int32_t)obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample;
296  hwaParamCfg.source.srcBcnt = (uint16_t)obj->numDopplerGatesPerPing - 1U;
297  hwaParamCfg.source.srcRealComplex = obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.isReal;
298  hwaParamCfg.source.srcScale = 8U;
299  if ((obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample == 2U) ||
300  ((obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample == 4U) &&
301  (obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.isReal == 0U)))
302  {
303  hwaParamCfg.source.srcWidth = HWA_SAMPLES_WIDTH_16BIT;
304  }
305  else
306  {
307  hwaParamCfg.source.srcWidth = HWA_SAMPLES_WIDTH_32BIT;
308  }
309  hwaParamCfg.source.srcSign = obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.isSigned;
310  hwaParamCfg.source.srcConjugate = 0;
311 
312  /* DEST CONFIG */
313  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWADDMA_ADDR_CFAR_PING_OUT;
314 
315  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAcnt = ((uint16_t)obj->cfarOutSize / (uint16_t)obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.bytesPerSample) - 1U;
316  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAIdx = (int32_t)obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.bytesPerSample;
317  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstBIdx = (int32_t)obj->numCfarSamples * (int32_t)obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.bytesPerSample;
318 
319  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstRealComplex = obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.isReal;
320  if ((obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.bytesPerSample == 2U) ||
321  ((obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.bytesPerSample == 4U) &&
322  (obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.isReal == 0U)))
323  {
324  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstWidth = HWA_SAMPLES_WIDTH_16BIT;
325  }
326  else
327  {
328  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstWidth = HWA_SAMPLES_WIDTH_32BIT;
329  }
330  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstSign = obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.isSigned;
331  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstConjugate = HWA_FEATURE_BIT_DISABLE;
332  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstScale = 8U;
333  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstSkipInit = 0;
334 
335  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(obj->hwaHandle,
336  pingHwParamsetIdx,
337  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
338  if (errCode != 0)
339  {
340  goto exit;
341  }
342 
343  errCode = HWA_getDMAChanIndex(obj->hwaHandle, (uint8_t)cfg->res.edmaOut.pingPong[0].channel, &destChan);
344  if (errCode != 0)
345  {
346  goto exit;
347  }
348  /* enable the DMA hookup to this paramset so that data gets copied out */
349  paramISRConfig.interruptTypeFlag = HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA;
350  paramISRConfig.dma.dstChannel = destChan;
351  errCode = HWA_enableParamSetInterrupt(obj->hwaHandle, pingHwParamsetIdx, &paramISRConfig);
352  if (errCode != 0)
353  {
354  goto exit;
355  }
356  }
357  }
358 
359  /*******************************/
360  /* PONG RANGE CFAR PARAMSET */
361  /*******************************/
362  {
363  {
364 
365  /* adcbuf not mapped, HWA is triggered after edma copy is done */
366  hwaParamCfg.triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
367  hwaParamCfg.triggerSrc = obj->hwaDmaTriggerSourcePingPongIn[1];
368 
369  /* SRC CONFIG */
370  hwaParamCfg.source.srcAddr = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWADDMA_ADDR_CFAR_PONG_IN;
371 
372  /* DEST CONFIG */
373  hwaParamCfg.dest.dstAddr = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWADDMA_ADDR_CFAR_PONG_OUT;
374 
375  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(obj->hwaHandle,
376  pongHwParamsetIdx,
377  &hwaParamCfg, NULL);
378  if (errCode != 0)
379  {
380  goto exit;
381  }
382 
383  errCode = HWA_getDMAChanIndex(obj->hwaHandle, (uint8_t)cfg->res.edmaOut.pingPong[1].channel, &destChan);
384  if (errCode != 0)
385  {
386  goto exit;
387  }
388  /* enable the DMA hookup to this paramset so that data gets copied out */
389  paramISRConfig.interruptTypeFlag = HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA;
390  paramISRConfig.dma.dstChannel = destChan;
391  errCode = HWA_enableParamSetInterrupt(obj->hwaHandle, pongHwParamsetIdx, &paramISRConfig);
392  if (errCode != 0)
393  {
394  goto exit;
395  }
396  }
397  }
398 
399 exit:
400  return (errCode);
401 }

418 static int32_t DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_configEdmaDetMatIn
419 (
420  DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Obj *obj,
421  DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Config *cfg
422 )
423 {
424 
425  DPEDMA_syncABCfg syncABCfg;
426  DPEDMA_ChainingCfg chainingCfg;
427  int32_t retVal;
428 
429  if(obj == NULL)
430  {
431  retVal = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_EINVAL;
432  goto exit;
433  }
434 
435  /* Program EDMA Data in from Decompressed Radar Cube scratch buffer to HWA Memory */
436  /* PING */
437  {{
438  chainingCfg.chainingChannel = (uint8_t)cfg->res.edmaInSignature.pingPong[0].channel;
439  chainingCfg.isIntermediateChainingEnabled = true;
440  chainingCfg.isFinalChainingEnabled = true;
441 
442  syncABCfg.srcAddress = (uint32_t)(cfg->res.detMatrix.data);
443  syncABCfg.destAddress = (uint32_t)(obj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWADDMA_HWA_MEM_BANK_CFAR_PING_IN]);
444  syncABCfg.aCount = (uint16_t)obj->numDopplerGatesPerPing * (uint16_t)obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample;
445  syncABCfg.bCount = (uint16_t)obj->numRangeBins;
446  syncABCfg.cCount = (uint16_t)obj->numLoops;
447  syncABCfg.srcBIdx = ((int32_t)obj->numDopplerBins / (int32_t)obj->numSubBandsTotal) * (int32_t)obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample;
448  syncABCfg.dstBIdx = (int32_t)obj->numDopplerGatesPerPing * (int32_t)obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample;
449  syncABCfg.srcCIdx = (int16_t)obj->numDopplerGatesPerPing * (int16_t)obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample * 2;
450  syncABCfg.dstCIdx = 0;
451 
452  retVal = DPEDMA_configSyncAB( cfg->res.edmaHandle,
453  &cfg->res.edmaIn.pingPong[0],
454  &chainingCfg,
455  &syncABCfg,
456  false,//isEventTriggered
457  false, //isIntermediateTransferCompletionEnabled
458  false,//isTransferCompletionEnabled
459  NULL, //transferCompletionCallbackFxn
460  NULL,
461  NULL);//transferCompletionCallbackFxnArg
462  if (retVal != SystemP_SUCCESS)
463  {
464  goto exit;
465  }
466 
467  /* One Hot Signature to trigger the HWA */
468  retVal = DPEDMAHWA_configOneHotSignature( cfg->res.edmaHandle,
469  &cfg->res.edmaInSignature.pingPong[0],
470  obj->hwaHandle,
471  obj->hwaDmaTriggerSourcePingPongIn[0],
472  false);
473  if (retVal != SystemP_SUCCESS)
474  {
475  goto exit;
476  }
477  }}
478 
479  /* PONG */
480  {{
481  chainingCfg.chainingChannel = (uint8_t)cfg->res.edmaInSignature.pingPong[1].channel;
482  syncABCfg.srcAddress = (uint32_t)((uint8_t *)cfg->res.detMatrix.data +
483  (obj->numDopplerGatesPerPing * obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample));
484  syncABCfg.destAddress = (uint32_t)(obj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWADDMA_HWA_MEM_BANK_CFAR_PONG_IN]);
485  retVal = DPEDMA_configSyncAB(cfg->res.edmaHandle,
486  &cfg->res.edmaIn.pingPong[1],
487  &chainingCfg,
488  &syncABCfg,
489  false,//isEventTriggered
490  false, //isIntermediateTransferCompletionEnabled
491  false,//isTransferCompletionEnabled
492  NULL, //transferCompletionCallbackFxn
493  NULL,//transferCompletionCallbackFxnArg
494  NULL);
495  if (retVal != SystemP_SUCCESS)
496  {
497  goto exit;
498  }
499 
500  /* One Hot Signature to trigger the HWA */
501  retVal = DPEDMAHWA_configOneHotSignature(cfg->res.edmaHandle,
502  &cfg->res.edmaInSignature.pingPong[1],
503  obj->hwaHandle,
504  obj->hwaDmaTriggerSourcePingPongIn[1],
505  false);
506 
507  }}
508 
509 exit:
510  return(retVal);
511 
512 }

631  volatile uint8_t subframeCounter,
632  int32_t* errCode
633 )
634 {
635  DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Obj *obj = NULL;
636  int32_t status = SystemP_SUCCESS;
637  HWA_MemInfo hwaMemInfo;
638  uint8_t memBankIdx;
639 
640  *errCode = 0;
641 
642  if ((initCfg == NULL) || (initCfg->hwaHandle == NULL))
643  {
644  *errCode = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_EINVAL;
645  goto exit;
646  }
647 
648  DebugP_assert(subframeCounter < RL_MAX_SUBFRAMES);
649 
650  obj = (DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Obj*)&cfarProcObjPool;
651 
652  /* Save for debugging */
653 #ifdef DBG_CFAR_HWA_OBJ_DPU
654  if (gDPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_ObjInd < RL_MAX_SUBFRAMES)
655  {
656  gDPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Obj[gDPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_ObjInd++] = obj;
657  }
658 #endif
659 
660  /* Create semaphore for EDMA Out done */
661  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&obj->cfarPingEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle, 0);
662  if(status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
663  {
664  *errCode = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_ESEMA;
665  goto exit;
666  }
667 
668  /* Create semaphore for EDMA Out done */
669  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&obj->cfarPongEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle, 0);
670  if(status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
671  {
672  *errCode = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_ESEMA;
673  goto exit;
674  }
675 
676  /* Save init config params */
677  obj->hwaHandle = initCfg->hwaHandle;
678 
679  /* Populate HWA base addresses and offsets. This is done only once, at init time.*/
680  *errCode = HWA_getHWAMemInfo(obj->hwaHandle, &hwaMemInfo);
681  if (*errCode < 0)
682  {
683  goto exit;
684  }
685 
686  /* check if we have enough memory banks*/
687  if(hwaMemInfo.numBanks < DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_NUM_HWA_MEMBANKS)
688  {
689  *errCode = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_ERROR_HWRES;
690  goto exit;
691  }
692 
693  for (memBankIdx = 0; memBankIdx < DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_NUM_HWA_MEMBANKS; memBankIdx++)
694  {
695  obj->hwaMemBankAddr[memBankIdx] = hwaMemInfo.baseAddress + (uint32_t)memBankIdx * (uint32_t)hwaMemInfo.bankSize;
696  }
697 
698 exit:
699 
700  if(*errCode < 0)
701  {
702  /* Free the object if it was allocated */
703  if(obj != NULL)
704  {
705  obj = NULL;
706  }
707  }
708 
709  return ((DPU_RangeCFARProcHWA_Handle)obj);
710 }

747  goto exit;
748  }
749 
750  RangeCFARHWA_saveConfiguration(obj, cfg);
751 
752  obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.isReal = 1U;
753  obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample = (uint8_t)pRes->detMatBytesPerSample;
754  obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.isSigned = 0U;
755  obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.isReal = 0U;
756  obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.bytesPerSample = (uint8_t)sizeof(cmplx32ImRe_t);
757  obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.isSigned = 0U;
758 
759  obj->numCfarSamples = cfg->staticCfg.numRangeBins;
760  retVal = dpuRangeCfarProcDDMA_numDopplerGatesPerPing(cfg->staticCfg.numRangeBins,
761  (uint32_t)cfg->staticCfg.numDopplerBins / (uint32_t)obj->numSubBandsTotal,
762  obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.input.bytesPerSample,
763  DPU_RANFECFARPROCHWADDMA_HWA_MEMBANK_SIZE_BYTES,
764  &obj->numDopplerGatesPerPing,
765  &obj->cfarInSize,
766  &obj->numLoops);
767  if(retVal < 0)
768  {
769  retVal = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWADDMA_NUM_GATES_PER_PING_ERR;
770  goto exit;
771  }

773  obj->cfarOutSize = cfg->res.maxNumCFARObj * obj->rangeCfarIOCfg.output.bytesPerSample / (2U * obj->numLoops);
774 
775  retVal = HWA_getDMAChanIndex(obj->hwaHandle, (uint8_t)cfg->res.edmaInSignature.pingPong[0].channel, &obj->hwaDmaTriggerSourcePingPongIn[0]);
776  if (retVal != 0)
777  {
778  goto exit;
779  }

782  {
783  goto exit;
784  }
785 
786  if(obj->rangeCfarCfg->averageMode == HWA_NOISE_AVG_MODE_CFAR_OS)
787  {
788  /* Guard Window is not required in case of CFAR OS */

790  {

798  && (obj->rangeCfarCfg->averageMode != HWA_NOISE_AVG_MODE_CFAR_CASO))

805  /**************************************/

807  /**************************************/
808 
809  /* Disable the HWA */

811  if (retVal != 0)
812  {
813  goto exit;

834  }

840 static int32_t dpuRangeCfarProcDDMA_cfarObjCumSum(DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Obj *obj, DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Config *cfg)
841 {
842  uint16_t *cfarNumObjPerDopList = (uint16_t *) cfg->res.rangeCfarNumObjPerDopplerBinBuf;
843  uint16_t numLoops = (obj->numDopplerBins / obj->numSubBandsTotal);
844  uint16_t loopIdx;
845  int32_t retVal = 0;
846 
847  for(loopIdx = 1; loopIdx < numLoops; loopIdx++)
848  {
849  cfarNumObjPerDopList[loopIdx] += cfarNumObjPerDopList[loopIdx - 1U];
850  }
851 
852  CacheP_wbInv(cfarNumObjPerDopList, cfg->res.rangeCfarNumObjPerDopplerBinSizeBytes, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
853 
854  return retVal;
855 
856 }

872 static int32_t dpuRangeCfarProcDDMA_createRangeCfarList(DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Obj *obj,
873  DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Config *cfg,
874  uint32_t blockIdx)
875 {
876 
877  uint8_t * cfarMat;
878  uint32_t numCfarPeaks, CFARNoiseCurr;
879  uint32_t loopIdx, cfarResReal, cfarResImag;
880  uint32_t rangeIdx, dopIdx;
881  RangeCfarListObj * currObjParams;
882  uint16_t * cfarNumObjPerDopList;
883  int32_t retVal = 0;
884  uint32_t numLoops;
885 
886  if((blockIdx % 2U) == 0U)
887  {
888  numCfarPeaks = obj->numCfarPeaksPing;
889  }
890  else
891  {
892  numCfarPeaks = obj->numCfarPeaksPong;
893  }
894 
895  /* Assign local matrix pointers based on ping/pong */
896  cfarMat = (uint8_t *) cfg->res.rangeCfarScratchBuf[blockIdx % 2U];
897  cfarNumObjPerDopList = (uint16_t *) cfg->res.rangeCfarNumObjPerDopplerBinBuf;
898 
899  if(numCfarPeaks > cfg->res.maxNumCFARObj / (2U * obj->numLoops))
900  {
901  numLoops = cfg->res.maxNumCFARObj / (2U * obj->numLoops);
902  }
903  else
904  {
905  numLoops = numCfarPeaks;
906  }
907  /* Loop through CFAR peaks and check whether an object is present for a particular peak. If it is present,
908  store its parameters in the output list */
909  for(loopIdx = 0U; loopIdx < numLoops; loopIdx++)
910  {
911  currObjParams = &cfg->res.rangeCfarList[obj->numObjOut++];
912 
913  /* To get the real and imag part */
914  cfarResImag = *(uint32_t *)(&cfarMat[loopIdx * sizeof(cmplx32ImRe_t)]);
915  cfarResReal = *(uint32_t *)(&cfarMat[(loopIdx * sizeof(cmplx32ImRe_t)) + (sizeof(cmplx32ImRe_t) / 2U)]);
916  CFARNoiseCurr = cfarResImag;
917 
918  dopIdx = (cfarResReal) >> 12;
919  rangeIdx = (cfarResReal) - (dopIdx << 12);
920 
921  currObjParams->rangeIdx = rangeIdx;
922  currObjParams->dopIdx = dopIdx + (obj->numDopplerGatesPerPing * blockIdx);
923  currObjParams->rangeCFARNoise = CFARNoiseCurr;
924 
925  if(currObjParams->dopIdx < (obj->numDopplerBins / obj->numSubBandsTotal))
926  {
927  cfarNumObjPerDopList[dopIdx + (obj->numDopplerGatesPerPing * blockIdx)]++;
928  }
929  else
930  {
931  DebugP_log("Wrong Object! RIdx = %d, DIdx = %d\n", currObjParams->rangeIdx, currObjParams->dopIdx);
932  retVal = -1;
933  goto exit;
934  }
935  }
936 
937 exit:
938  return retVal;
939 }

988 int32_t DPU_RangeCFARProcHWA_process
989 (
990  DPU_RangeCFARProcHWA_Handle handle,
991  DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Config *cfg,
992  DPU_RangeCFARProcHWA_OutParams *outParams
993 )
994 {
995 
996  int32_t retVal = 0;
997  int32_t status;
998  uint32_t loopIdx;
999 
1000  DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Obj *obj;
1001 
1002  if (handle == NULL)
1003  {
1004  retVal = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_EINVAL;
1005  goto exit;
1006  }
1007 
1008  obj = (DPU_RangeCfarProcHWA_Obj *)handle;
1009 
1010  obj->numObjOut = 0;
1011  outParams->stats.processingTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
1012 
1013  CacheP_inv(cfg->res.rangeCfarScratchBuf[0], cfg->res.rangeCfarScratchBufSizeBytes / 2U, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
1014  CacheP_inv(cfg->res.rangeCfarScratchBuf[1], cfg->res.rangeCfarScratchBufSizeBytes / 2U, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
1015  /* Initialize memory */
1016  (void)memset((void *)cfg->res.rangeCfarNumObjPerDopplerBinBuf, 0, cfg->res.rangeCfarNumObjPerDopplerBinSizeBytes);
1017 
1018  /* Disable the HWA */
1019  retVal = HWA_enable(obj->hwaHandle,0);
1020  if (retVal != 0)
1021  {
1022  goto exit;
1023  }
1024 
1025  /* Config HWA Common */
1026  retVal = dpuRangeCfarProcHwaDDMA_ConfigHWACommon(obj, cfg);
1027  if(retVal < 0)
1028  {
1029  goto exit;
1030  }
1031 
1032  /* Enable the HWA */
1033  retVal = HWA_enable(obj->hwaHandle,1);
1034  if (retVal != 0)
1035  {
1036  goto exit;
1037  }
1038 
1039  for(loopIdx = 0; loopIdx < obj->numLoops; loopIdx++)
1040  {
1041 
1042  outParams->stats.timeLoop = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
1043 
1044  /* Trigger ping EDMA */
1045  retVal = DPEDMA_edmaStartTransferManualTrigger(cfg->res.edmaHandle, (uint32_t)cfg->res.edmaIn.pingPong[0].channel);
1046  if (retVal != 0)
1047  {
1048  goto exit;
1049  }
1050 
1051  /* Pong CFAR Extract Objects*/
1052  if(loopIdx != 0U)
1053  {
1054  outParams->stats.timeDsp[1] = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
1055  retVal = dpuRangeCfarProcDDMA_createRangeCfarList(obj, cfg, (2U * loopIdx) - 1U);
1056  if (retVal != 0)
1057  {
1058  goto exit;
1059  }
1060  outParams->stats.timeDsp[1] = CycleCounterP_getCount32() - outParams->stats.timeDsp[1];
1061  }
1062 
1063  /* Wait for EDMA Out (ping) */
1064  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->cfarPingEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
1065  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1066  {
1067  retVal = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_ESEMA;
1068  goto exit;
1069  }
1070 
1071  /* Read CFAR Ping Peak Regs */
1072  retVal = HWA_readCFARPeakCountReg(obj->hwaHandle, (uint8_t *)&obj->numCfarPeaksPing, (uint8_t)sizeof(uint32_t));
1073  if (retVal != 0)
1074  {
1075  goto exit;
1076  }
1077 
1078  /* Trigger pong EDMA */
1079  retVal = DPEDMA_edmaStartTransferManualTrigger(cfg->res.edmaHandle, (uint32_t)cfg->res.edmaIn.pingPong[1].channel);
1080  if (retVal != 0)
1081  {
1082  goto exit;
1083  }
1084 
1085  /* Ping CFAR Extract Objects*/
1086  outParams->stats.timeDsp[0] = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
1087  retVal = dpuRangeCfarProcDDMA_createRangeCfarList(obj, cfg, 2U * loopIdx);
1088  if (retVal != 0)
1089  {
1090  goto exit;
1091  }
1092  outParams->stats.timeDsp[0] = CycleCounterP_getCount32() - outParams->stats.timeDsp[0];
1093 
1094  /* Wait for EDMA Out (pong) */
1095  status = SemaphoreP_pend(&obj->cfarPongEdmaOutDoneSemaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
1096  if (status != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1097  {
1098  retVal = DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_ESEMA;
1099  goto exit;
1100  }
1101 
1102  /* Read CFAR Pong Peak Regs */
1103  retVal = HWA_readCFARPeakCountReg(obj->hwaHandle, (uint8_t *)&obj->numCfarPeaksPong, (uint8_t)sizeof(uint32_t));
1104  if (retVal != 0)
1105  {
1106  goto exit;
1107  }
1108 
1109  outParams->stats.timeLoop = CycleCounterP_getCount32() - outParams->stats.timeLoop;
1110 
1111  }
1112 
1113  /* Final Pong CFAR Extract Object */
1114  retVal = dpuRangeCfarProcDDMA_createRangeCfarList(obj, cfg, (2U * loopIdx) - 1U);
1115  if (retVal != 0)
1116  {
1117  goto exit;
1118  }
1119 
1120  /* Cumulative sum of CFAR Object List */
1121  retVal = dpuRangeCfarProcDDMA_cfarObjCumSum(obj, cfg);
1122  if (retVal != 0)
1123  {
1124  goto exit;
1125  }
1126 
1127  /* Disable the HWA */
1128  retVal = HWA_enable(obj->hwaHandle, 0);
1129  if (retVal != 0)
1130  {
1131  goto exit;
1132  }
1133 
1134  CacheP_inv(cfg->res.rangeCfarScratchBuf[0], cfg->res.rangeCfarScratchBufSizeBytes / 2U, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
1135  CacheP_inv(cfg->res.rangeCfarScratchBuf[1], cfg->res.rangeCfarScratchBufSizeBytes / 2U, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
1136 
1137  outParams->stats.processingTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32() - outParams->stats.processingTime;
1138 
1139  outParams->numCfarDetectedPoints = obj->numObjOut;
1140 
1141 exit:
1142  return (retVal);
1143 }
